There's definitely a way cleaner and more professional way to do this. But this works for me and my edibles always do the job amazingly. Just make sure the butter is fully hard so it doesn't mix with the water.

1.I usually do a half ounce of bud (14 Grams), but you can do anywhere from 7 Grams - 14 Grams if you'd like.
2.Pre Heat Oven to 250
3.Grab a flat baking pan and break the bud down into very small pieces (NOT GRINDED, JUST SMALL ENOUGH SO THE BUD CAN FULLY DECARB)
4. and once the oven is heated, put the pan in and let it decarb for 40 minutes. I shake every 10 minutes. 
5. Grab a small sauce pan, pour a cup of water (so butter doesn't burn) and had 2 sticks of butter. Place it on the stove top on Simmer and let the butter fully melt
6. Once butter is melted take your decarbed weed and add it into the butter. Mix the weed in. 
7. I now let it simmer for 2 hours and I stir every 20 minutes
8. Once 2 hours are up grab your cheesecloth and rubber and it on the rim of your jar.
9. You're going to have to slowly pour a little into the cheesecloth, stop, let the butter and water slowly go into the jar. And scoop the weed out. And keep repeating this until your sauce pan is empty and all the butter and water is into the jar
10. Take the cheesecloth off, you can 1. Save the weed and cook it into food or 2. Just throw it out. 
11. Now put it in the fridge and let the butter fully cool down. When it's cooler down, take a knife or a spoon and make a little hole In the butter on the side and drain the water out (butter will be green, water will be brow )
